_: The cast. Every story on the site is told with these people and things, so that a reader who has met Maya once knows her the next time. v0.1 was drawn by a ChatGPT image model on 26 September 2026 from the lead's prompt; the names, roles and lines are as drawn. Only `stands_for` and `look` are ours.

drawn.alt: Meet the cast: nine framed portraits in a clean line-cartoon style, six people in green and three things, each with a name, a role and one line.
drawn.title: Meet the cast. Small requests. Big capabilities.

style: Clean line cartoon: thick ink outlines, flat fills, no gradients. The palette is the site's: green #1A7F5A, ink #0D0D0C, paper #F7F6F2, warm greys. An office with plants and pale wood. Everybody wears something green. Speech in rounded bubbles, British spelling. Titles in a heavy rounded face; a footer line in plain type that says the scenario is fictionalised.

people.name: Maya
people.line: I only asked for a draft.
people.stands_for: The person who connects an agent to get one small thing done, and finds it can do more than they asked. The rep in the role-ownership article; the one whose mandate is read and draft.
people.look: Long dark curly hair, hoop earrings, green shirt, a laptop and a mug, mid-gesture.
people.asks: What did I just switch on?

people.name: Rowan
people.stands_for: Speed. The person who says yes to the pilot and is surprised when it is switched off. The founder of the pilots article.
people.look: Red hair and beard, green overshirt, a notebook, checking a watch.

people.name: Imani
people.stands_for: The person the map routes a risk to, and who has to say what was authorised. Holds risks, places them, asks for the mandate.
people.look: Short natural hair, glasses, green blazer, a pen and a clipboard marked RISK REVIEW.
people.asks: Who authorised that, and until when?

people.name: Dev
people.stands_for: The person who reads the consent screen and the scope, and can put a boundary in place. Says what the grant is, in the grant's words.
people.look: Dark curly hair, green overshirt, holding a cable, a laptop showing a SEND PERMISSIONS toggle.
people.asks: What does the scope actually grant?
people.note: A character called Dev in stories about developers will confuse readers; a rename is a decision for the lead.

people.name: Ruth
people.stands_for: The board: where every path ends, and who asks the two questions of any register.
people.look: Silver bob, glasses, black jacket, green scarf, a bundle of BOARD PAPERS.
people.asks: Who has accepted this, and until when?

people.name: Leo
people.stands_for: The person who runs the day on the shared calendar and the shared systems, and who finds out that an edit has no way back.
people.look: Dark hair, green polo, in a wheelchair, holding an INCIDENT LOG with an undo arrow.
people.asks: Can we undo it, and how far back?

things.name: The Caretaker
things.stands_for: The agent: the grant on legs. It means well, it holds a ring of keys it was given, and it does not know which of them it was meant to use.
things.look: A white and green robot with a name badge that says AGENT, a clipboard or a draft in one hand, and a ring of keys tagged with a calendar, a database, a document and an envelope.

things.name: The Inbox
things.stands_for: The system the agent acts on, which sees everything and can stop nothing.
things.look: A green in-tray full of envelopes, with a face, a mug beside it.

things.name: The Boundary
things.stands_for: The one barrier that is a control: enforced by something the agent cannot reach. A gate arm, not a sign.
things.look: A green bollard and barrier with a face, arms folded, a no-entry sign on the post.

proposed.name: to be named
proposed.line: Accepted, for a month. Then it comes back to me.
proposed.why: The site's main idea, accepting a risk for a stated interval, has nobody in the cast to do it. A person with a pen and a date. Alternatively Imani takes the line.
